CustomField.description: Semicolon separated Emirates IDs allowed to enter pin mode, checked together with ADHA_Applicant__c.Is_Ops__c on every ops call - both or nothing. Blank means nobody. Unmodifiable from the site by construction: custom metadata cannot be written by guest-context Apex. Must also be added to the SELECT in ADHA_JourneyController.settings() or it reads as null.
CustomField.label: Ops Emirates Ids
